1.t: By the sky with its towering constellations,

3.t: by the Witness and that which is witnessed,

4.t: damned were the makers of the trench,

5.t: the makers of the fuel-stoked fire!

7.t: to watch what they were doing to the believers.

8.t: Their only grievance against them was their faith in God, the Mighty, the Praiseworthy,

9.t: to whom all control over the heavens and earth belongs: God is witness over all things.

10.t: For those who persecute believing men and women, and do not repent afterwards, there will be the torment of Hell and burning.

11.t: But for those who believe and do good deeds there will be Gardens graced with flowing streams: that is the great triumph.

12.t: [Prophet], your Lord’s punishment is truly stern––

13.t: it is He who brings people to life, and will restore them to life again––

14.t: and He is the Most Forgiving, the Most Loving.

15.t: The Glorious Lord of the Throne,

17.t: Have you [not] heard the stories of the forces

19.t: Yet still the disbelievers persist in denial.

21.t: This is truly a glorious Quran
